import sys, threading
sys.path.insert(0, "src")
sys.path.insert(0, "tests")

import requests
import requests.adapters as adapters
from testserver.server import TLSServer, consume_socket_content

# Simulate certifi's default bundle already trusting our local test CA
# (stand-in for "the server's cert chains to a publicly-trusted root").
adapters._preloaded_ssl_context.load_verify_locations("tests/certs/valid/ca/ca.crt")

mtls_cert = (
    "tests/certs/mtls/client/client.pem",
    "tests/certs/mtls/client/client.key",
)

seen_certs = {}

def make_handler(name):
    def handler(sock):
        seen_certs[name] = sock.getpeercert()
        consume_socket_content(sock, timeout=0.5)
        sock.send(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n")
    return handler

close_a = threading.Event()
server_a = TLSServer(
    handler=make_handler("A"),
    wait_to_close_event=close_a,
    requests_to_handle=1,
    cert_chain="tests/certs/valid/server/server.pem",
    keyfile="tests/certs/valid/server/server.key",
    mutual_tls=True,
    cacert="tests/certs/mtls/client/ca/ca.crt",
)

s = requests.Session()

with server_a as (host, port):
    url_a = f"https://{host}:{port}"
    r1 = s.get(url_a, verify=True, cert=mtls_cert)
    print("request A status:", r1.status_code)
    close_a.set()

print("Server A saw client cert:", seen_certs.get("A") is not None)

close_b = threading.Event()
server_b = TLSServer(
    handler=make_handler("B"),
    wait_to_close_event=close_b,
    requests_to_handle=1,
    cert_chain="tests/certs/valid/server/server.pem",
    keyfile="tests/certs/valid/server/server.key",
    mutual_tls=True,
    cacert="tests/certs/mtls/client/ca/ca.crt",
)

with server_b as (host, port):
    url_b = f"https://{host}:{port}"
    # NOTE: no cert= here at all.
    r2 = s.get(url_b, verify=True)
    print("request B status:", r2.status_code)
    close_b.set()

print("Server B saw a client cert despite request B never supplying one:", seen_certs.get("B") is not None)
if seen_certs.get("B") is not None:
    print("LEAKED CERT SUBJECT SEEN BY SERVER B:", seen_certs["B"].get("subject"))
EOF
